comparison.objective: Replace an electric-toothbrush head, including opening its package and discarding the worn head; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Open snap packaging and perform axial pull-fit removal and push-fit insertion while stabilizing the handle.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the new head fully seated, the old head binned, and release; candidate requires a locked target angle retained through actuation.
comparison.reason: Push-fit replacement and packaging manipulation do not test threaded setting adjustment or countertorque locking.
